name: 20396-smallbatchdecode-8bfp8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, no expert parallel, no data parallel.
architecture: Dense LlamaForCausalLM: 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256; compressed-tensors fp8 e4m3, lm_head bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 8, bounded at 480 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, configs/data/sharegpt-480-out300-llama31-8b-fp8.jsonl -- 480 real ShareGPT first turns, each carrying `output_tokens_count: 300` (guidellm sends max_tokens=300 with ignore_eos, so every request generates exactly 300). 103374 input tokens total, mean 215.4, p50 83, p90 619, max 933. Sent as `request_format: plain`, no chat template. configs/data/make-dataset.py regenerates the draw.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant giving 300-token replies to eight concurrent users on a single GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line at the pinned commit. Every value is written out rather than left
# to a default, because this engine's defaults for the token budgets vary with build context.
model: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
